name: Spacecraft cabin (e.g. Orion)
why: We found no current NASA figures for this cabin's oxygen and pressure, only proposals from 2010-11 that were later replaced, so there is no air range to count tests in.
what_would_change: When NASA publishes the cabin's oxygen and pressure, it becomes a card with test counts automatically. Until then, try your own values in the air-conditions filter.

name: Mars habitat
why: The challenge gives no air range for Mars, and we found no current NASA figures, only proposals from 2010-11 that were later replaced. No PSI test ran in Mars gravity.
what_would_change: When NASA publishes a Mars habitat's oxygen and pressure, it becomes a card with test counts automatically. Until then, try your own values in the air-conditions filter.
